decisions.choice: verse numbers: in the Hebrew text this verse begins chapter 12
decisions.reason: This translation numbers verses as the Hebrew text does. In the Hebrew text chapter 11 ends with the crowning of Jehoash and the death of Athaliah (11:20), and this verse, giving the young king's age, begins chapter 12. Many Bibles number it 11:21 and so number the rest of this chapter (12:2-22 here) 12:1-21. The words are the same; only the numbers differ.

decisions.choice: a son of seven years: seven years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being the son of so many years. Jehoash had been hidden in the temple for six years while Athaliah ruled (11:3), and Jehoiada made him king in the seventh (11:4, 12).

decisions.choice: Jehoash: the same king called Joash
decisions.reason: The name means "Yahweh has given". Kings uses the longer form Jehoash for him in this chapter until verse 20, and the shorter form Joash in 11:2 and in verses 20-21; both name the one king of Judah, son of Ahaziah (11:2).

decisions.choice: Jehoash was seven years old
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the age as English does and put the name first; Literal keeps the Hebrew order and idiom.

decisions.choice: Joás (for both Jehoash and Joash)
decisions.reason: The terms note gives Spanish one form, "Joás", for the long and short Hebrew spellings of this king's name, so Spanish does not mark the difference the English keeps; the meaning decision notes it.

decisions.choice: "Yehoash" (here); "Joas" where the Hebrew has the short form (verses 20-21)
decisions.reason: French keeps each verse’s form of the king’s name, as the English and the Kings terms note do.

decisions.choice: "Giê-hô-ách"
decisions.reason: The verse gives the king's long form, and Vietnamese follows it, as the terms note keeps each verse's form (Giê-hô-ách / Giô-ách); the meaning decision says it is the same king (m3).

decisions.choice: "여호아스" here, as the English "Jehoash", and "요아스" where the verse says Joash (11:2)
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles terms note, each verse keeps its own form of the name.

decisions.choice: Joás (the king of Judah, both forms of the name); Jeoás (the king of Israel, 13:10-14:16)
alternatives: Jeoás here and Joás from verse 20, as the Hebrew and the English
decisions.reason: For the whole book. The Hebrew calls the king of Judah by the long form of his name (Jehoash) up to verse 19 and by the short form (Joash) from verse 20 (m3), and the English keeps each form. The Portuguese long form, "Jeoás", is the name the shared list for Kings gives the king of Israel who reigns in 13:10-14:16, so keeping it here would make readers take the two kings for one; Portuguese calls the king of Judah "Joás" in every verse and the king of Israel "Jeoás" in every verse, whichever form the Hebrew uses. The meaning note says that both forms name one man. The age is given with a bracketed "tinha" at Literal, as the accession formula is worded in 1 Kings 14:21.

vi.R: Giê-hô-ách lên làm vua vào năm thứ bảy đời Giê-hu làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Vua cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem bốn mươi năm. Mẹ vua là Xi-bia, người Bê-e-Sê-ba.

ko.L: 예후 제7년에 여호아스가 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 40년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 브엘세바 출신 시비아였다.

decisions.choice: verse numbers: this is verse 1 of chapter 12 in many Bibles
decisions.reason: In the Hebrew text this is verse 2, because the Hebrew chapter begins one verse earlier (see verse 1). Many Bibles number this verse 12:1 and the following verses one lower than here, through 12:21 for verse 22.

decisions.choice: the seventh year of Jehu: dated by the reign of the king of Israel
decisions.reason: As Kings does for each reign, the start of Jehoash's reign in Judah is dated by the year of the king ruling in Israel. Jehu had come to power when he killed Joram of Israel and Ahaziah of Judah on the same day (9:24, 27), and Athaliah then ruled Judah for six years (11:3).

decisions.choice: his mother's name: the queen mother named in the formula
decisions.reason: For the kings of Judah the formula names the king's mother (1 Kings 15:2), who held a place of her own at court. Beersheba lay in the far south of Judah (1 Kings 5:5).

decisions.choice: two sentences, the date first named as Jehu's reign over Israel
decisions.reason: Readable splits the formula into short sentences, as these books allow, and names Israel so the reader knows which kingdom Jehu ruled.

decisions.choice: "Le nom de sa mère [était] ..." (L); "Sa mère s’appelait ..." (B, R)
alternatives: "Le nom de sa mère était" at every level
decisions.reason: The queen-mother formula of the Kings terms note.

decisions.choice: "Na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] ..." (Literal); "Mama yake aliitwa ..." (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The queen-mother formula follows the terms note's wording at each level through Kings.

decisions.choice: No Nº ano de X, Y reinou (L) / começou a reinar (B); Y se tornou rei no Nº ano em que X era rei de Israel (R); o nome da sua mãe [era] (L), A sua mãe se chamava (B), A mãe dele era (R); Zíbia, de Berseba
decisions.reason: The synchronism and the accession formula keep the wording 1 Kings 15:1-2 and 15:9-10 set at each level, with the year as an ordinal. The queen mother's name (m3) takes the accent Portuguese writes on its stressed syllable, "Zíbia"; "Berseba" as Genesis has it in Portuguese.

en.R: Jehoash did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was right all his days, because Jehoiada the priest taught him.

pt.B: Joás fez o que era reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} todos os seus dias, porque o sacerdote Joiada o instruiu.
pt.R: Joás fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava certo todos os seus dias, porque o sacerdote Joiada o ensinou.

decisions.choice: did what was right in Yahweh's eyes: the good verdict
decisions.reason: This is the good verdict of the regnal formula, given to the kings of Judah who were faithful to Yahweh (1 Kings 15:11). Verse 4 adds the one thing that held it back.

decisions.choice: all his days, because Jehoiada the priest instructed him
alternatives: all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him
as long as Jehoiada the priest instructed him
decisions.reason: The linking word can give the reason ("because") or limit the time ("all his days in which"). Read the first way, the verdict covers Jehoash's whole reign and names Jehoiada's teaching as what made it so. Read the second way, the verdict holds only for the years while Jehoiada taught him. 2 Chronicles 24:2 says he did right "all the days of Jehoiada the priest", and 2 Chronicles 24:17-22 tells how he turned away after Jehoiada died, which fits the second reading. Kings itself tells of no such turning.

decisions.choice: instructed: taught him the right way
decisions.reason: The verb means to teach or direct, the word from which torah, "instruction", comes. Jehoiada the priest had saved the boy, made him king and made the covenant between Yahweh, the king and the people (11:4-17).

decisions.choice: did the right in [the] eyes of / did what was right in the sight of / did what the LORD said was right
decisions.reason: The good verdict is worded the same way at each level throughout these books. "All his days" is kept at every level so that the question in m2 stays open; "taught" at Readable is the common word for "instructed".

decisions.choice: hizo lo recto a los ojos del SEÑOR (Literal, Balanced); hizo lo que agrada al SEÑOR (Readable)
decisions.reason: The good verdict of the terms note, one wording per level through Kings and Chronicles; "todos sus días" stays at every level so that the question in m2 stays open.

decisions.choice: "fit ce qui est droit" (L); "fit ce qui est juste" (B); "a fait ce que le SEIGNEUR déclare bon" (R)
decisions.reason: The good verdict of the Kings terms note, used for every king of Judah who receives it.

decisions.choice: "alifanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa BWANA" (Literal, Balanced); "alifanya yale BWANA aliyoyaona kuwa mema" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The good verdict keeps the terms note's wording at each level through Kings.

decisions.choice: "làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt CHÚA" (L); "trước mặt CHÚA" (B); "làm điều CHÚA cho là phải" (R)
decisions.reason: The good verdict in the terms note's wording, kept at each level through Kings.

decisions.choice: The good verdict: "...의 눈에 올바른 일을 했다" (L), "... 보시기에 올바른 일을 했다" (B), "...께서 옳다고 하신 일을 했다" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles terms note.

decisions.choice: todos os seus dias, porque ... o instruiu; Joiada
alternatives: todos os dias em que ... o instruiu
decisions.reason: The good verdict keeps the wording of 1 Kings 15:11 at each level. "Todos os seus dias" is kept at every level, as the English keeps "all his days", so that the question in m2 (his whole reign, or only the years of Jehoiada's teaching) stays open; "durante toda a sua vida" would settle it. The priest is "Joiada", the form 1 Kings gives Benaiah's father.

source.text: רַ֥ק הַבָּמ֖וֹת לֹא־סָ֑רוּ ע֥וֹד הָעָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽמְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּבָּמֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Only the high places not were removed; still the people [were] sacrificing and burning incense at the high places.

en.L: Only the high places were not removed; the people were still sacrificing and burning incense at the high places.
en.B: The high places, however, were not removed. The people still offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places.
en.R: But the hilltop shrines were not removed. The people still offered sacrifices and burned incense at the hilltop shrines.

es.L: Solo que los lugares altos no fueron quitados; el pueblo todavía ofrecía sacrificios y quemaba incienso en los lugares altos.
es.B: Sin embargo, los lugares altos no fueron quitados; el pueblo todavía ofrecía sacrificios y quemaba incienso en los lugares altos.
es.R: Pero no se quitaron los santuarios sobre las colinas. El pueblo todavía ofrecía sacrificios y quemaba incienso en los santuarios sobre las colinas.

fr.L: Seulement, les hauts lieux ne furent pas supprimés ; le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices et brûlait de l’encens sur les hauts lieux.
fr.B: Cependant les hauts lieux ne disparurent pas. Le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices et brûlait de l’encens sur les hauts lieux.
fr.R: Mais les sanctuaires sur les collines n’ont pas été supprimés. Le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices et brûlait de l’encens dans ces sanctuaires sur les collines.

sw.L: Ila mahali pa juu hapakuondolewa; watu walikuwa bado wakitoa dhabihu na kufukiza uvumba mahali pa juu.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, mahali pa juu hapakuondolewa. Watu waliendelea kutoa dhabihu na kufukiza uvumba mahali pa juu.
sw.R: Lakini patakatifu pa kilimani hapakuondolewa. Watu waliendelea kutoa dhabihu na kufukiza uvumba katika patakatifu pa kilimani.

vi.L: Song các nơi cao không bị dẹp bỏ; dân chúng vẫn dâng sinh tế và đốt hương trên các nơi cao.
vi.B: Tuy nhiên, các nơi cao không bị dẹp bỏ; dân chúng vẫn dâng sinh tế và đốt hương trên các nơi cao.
vi.R: Nhưng những nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao không bị dẹp bỏ. Dân chúng vẫn dâng sinh tế và đốt hương tại những nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao.

ko.L: 다만 산당들은 없어지지 않아서, 백성은 여전히 산당에서 제사를 드리고 분향했다.
ko.B: 그러나 산당들은 없어지지 않아서, 백성은 여전히 산당에서 제사를 드리고 분향했다.
ko.R: 그러나 산꼭대기 제단들은 없어지지 않았다. 그래서 백성은 여전히 산꼭대기 제단에서 제사를 드리고 향을 피웠다.

pt.L: Somente os altos não foram removidos; o povo ainda sacrificava e queimava incenso nos altos.
pt.B: Os altos, porém, não foram removidos. O povo ainda oferecia sacrifícios e queimava incenso nos altos.
pt.R: Mas os santuários no alto dos morros não foram removidos. O povo continuava oferecendo sacrifícios e queimando incenso nesses santuários.

decisions.choice: the high places were not removed: the reservation in the good verdict
decisions.reason: The high places were local places of worship. Kings counts it against even the good kings of Judah that they left them standing (1 Kings 15:14; 22:44), until Hezekiah and Josiah removed them (18:4; 23:8). The verb does not say who should have removed them.

decisions.choice: burning incense: or burning offerings so that their smoke rose
alternatives: making offerings go up in smoke
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something go up in smoke. It is used both of burning incense and of burning offerings on an altar; here, beside "sacrificing", it may mean either.

decisions.choice: high places (Literal, Balanced); hilltop shrines (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for this word in these books.

decisions.choice: los lugares altos (Literal, Balanced); los santuarios sobre las colinas (Readable)
decisions.reason: The high-places formula of the terms note has "lugares altos" with the same words each time; the Samuel note also keeps "lugar alto" at Balanced, so Balanced follows them rather than the table's "lugares altos". Readable says "santuarios sobre las colinas".

decisions.choice: "les hauts lieux" (L, B); "les sanctuaires sur les collines" (R)

en.B: Jehoash said to the priests, "All the money from the holy gifts that is brought into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the money of those who are counted, the money for persons at the value set for each, and all the money anyone is moved to bring into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}},
en.R: Jehoash said to the priests, "People bring money to the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as holy gifts. Some is the tax paid by each one who is counted. es.L: Y Joás dijo a los sacerdotes: «Todo el dinero de las cosas consagradas que se trae [a la] casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el dinero del que pasa [por el censo], el dinero de las personas, cada una según su valoración, todo el dinero que suba al corazón de cada uno traer [a la] casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}},
es.B: Joás les dijo a los sacerdotes: «Todo el dinero de las ofrendas consagradas que se trae a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: el dinero de los que son contados en el censo, el dinero por las personas según el valor fijado para cada una, y todo el dinero que cualquiera quiera traer voluntariamente a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}},
es.R: Joás les dijo a los sacerdotes: «La gente trae dinero al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} como ofrenda santa. Una parte es el impuesto que paga cada uno de los que son contados en el censo. Otra parte se paga cuando alguien hace un voto, según el precio fijado para cada persona. Y otra parte es el dinero que la gente decide traer al templo por su propia voluntad.

fr.L: Et Yehoash dit aux prêtres : « Tout l’argent des choses saintes qu’on apporte [dans la] maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, l’argent de [celui qui] passe [au recensement], l’argent des personnes, chacun [selon] son estimation, tout l’argent qu’il monte au cœur de quelqu’un d’apporter [dans la] maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}},
fr.B: Yehoash dit aux prêtres : « Tout l’argent des offrandes saintes qu’on apporte dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, l’argent de ceux qui sont recensés, l’argent des personnes selon la valeur fixée pour chacune, et tout l’argent que chacun a à cœur d’apporter à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}},
fr.R: Yehoash a dit aux prêtres : « Les gens apportent de l’argent au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} comme offrandes saintes. Une partie, c’est l’impôt payé par chaque personne recensée. Une partie est payée quand les gens font des vœux, au prix fixé pour chaque personne. Et une partie, c’est l’argent que les gens choisissent librement d’apporter au temple.

sw.L: Yehoashi akawaambia makuhani, "Fedha yote ya vitu vitakatifu inayoletwa [ndani ya] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, fedha ya [mtu] anayepita, fedha ya nafsi, kila mmoja [kwa] thamani yake, fedha yote inayompanda mtu moyoni kuileta [ndani ya] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}},
sw.B: Yehoashi akawaambia makuhani, "Fedha yote ya matoleo matakatifu inayoletwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, fedha ya wale wanaohesabiwa, fedha ya watu kwa thamani iliyowekwa kwa kila mmoja, na fedha yote ambayo mtu ameguswa moyoni kuileta katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}},
sw.R: Yehoashi akawaambia makuhani, "Watu huleta fedha katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama matoleo matakatifu. Fedha nyingine ni kodi inayolipwa na kila mtu anayehesabiwa. Nyingine hulipwa watu wanapoweka nadhiri, kwa bei iliyowekwa kwa kila mtu. Na nyingine ni fedha ambayo watu wanaamua wenyewe kuileta hekaluni.

vi.L: Giê-hô-ách nói với các thầy tế lễ: "Tất cả tiền của các vật thánh được đem vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tiền của người qua [kiểm tra], tiền chuộc người theo giá định cho mỗi người, và tất cả tiền mà lòng ai cảm động muốn đem vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}},
vi.B: Giê-hô-ách nói với các thầy tế lễ: "Tất cả tiền từ các lễ vật thánh được đem vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tức là tiền thuế của những người được kiểm tra, tiền chuộc người theo giá định cho mỗi người, và tất cả tiền mà ai tự nguyện đem vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}},
vi.R: Giê-hô-ách nói với các thầy tế lễ: "Người ta đem tiền đến đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm lễ vật thánh. Có tiền thuế mà mỗi người được kiểm tra phải nộp. Có tiền nộp khi người ta khấn hứa, theo giá định cho mỗi người. Lại có tiền người ta tự nguyện đem đến đền thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 여호아스가 제사장들에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들여오는 거룩한 것들의 모든 돈, 곧 [인구 조사를] 지나가는 자의 돈과 각 사람의 몸값으로 정한 돈과 사람이 마음에 감동을 받아 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 가져오는 모든 돈은,
ko.B: 여호아스가 제사장들에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 거룩한 예물로 들어오는 모든 돈, 곧 인구 조사를 받는 사람이 내는 돈과 사람마다 정해진 값대로 내는 돈과 누구든지 스스로 마음이 움직여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 가져오는 모든 돈은,
ko.R: 여호아스가 제사장들에게 말했다. "사람들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 거룩한 예물로 돈을 가져온다. 어떤 돈은 인구 조사를 받는 사람마다 내는 세금이다. 어떤 돈은 서원할 때에 사람마다 정해진 값대로 내는 돈이다. 또 어떤 돈은 사람들이 스스로 원해서 성전에 가져오는 돈이다.

pt.L: E Joás disse aos sacerdotes: "Toda a prata das coisas santas que é trazida [à] casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, a prata de [quem] passa [pelo censo], a prata das pessoas, cada um [segundo] a sua avaliação, toda a prata que sobe ao coração de um homem trazer [à] casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}},
pt.B: Joás disse aos sacerdotes: "Todo o dinheiro das ofertas sagradas que é trazido à casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o dinheiro dos que são contados no censo, o dinheiro pago pelas pessoas segundo o valor fixado para cada uma, e todo o dinheiro que alguém decide de coração trazer à casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}},
pt.R: Joás disse aos sacerdotes: "As pessoas trazem dinheiro ao templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} como ofertas sagradas. Uma parte é o imposto pago por cada pessoa contada no censo. Outra parte é paga quando as pessoas fazem votos, pelo preço fixado para cada pessoa. E outra parte é o dinheiro que as pessoas decidem trazer ao templo por vontade própria.

decisions.choice: the money of the holy things: money given to the temple as holy
decisions.reason: Holy things are gifts set apart for Yahweh and so belonging to the temple (1 Kings 15:15). The king names three kinds of such money in the rest of the verse.

decisions.choice: money of one passing over: the half-shekel paid by each one counted in a census
decisions.reason: The phrase is "money passing". The law says that everyone who "passes over" to those being counted is to give a half-shekel to Yahweh for the work of the tent of meeting (Exodus 30:12-16), and 2 Chronicles 24:6, 9 speaks of the tax Moses laid on Israel. The same words in Genesis 23:16 mean silver that passes in trade, that is, current money, and some read them that way here, as a heading for the money that follows.

decisions.choice: money of persons at his valuation: the price set for a person vowed to Yahweh
decisions.reason: Leviticus 27:2-8 lets someone who has vowed a person to Yahweh pay a set value instead, fixed by age and sex. This money came to the sanctuary.

decisions.choice: comes up on the heart of a man: what anyone freely decides to give
decisions.reason: Something "comes up on the heart" when a person thinks of it or chooses it. These are freewill gifts, given without any law requiring them (Exodus 35:21).

decisions.choice: the sentence goes on into verse 6
decisions.reason: The verse lists the money; verse 6 says what the priests are to do with it. The king's words run from here to the end of verse 6.

decisions.choice: the tax paid by each one who is counted; paid when people make vows
decisions.reason: Readable explains the two kinds of money (m2, m3) and turns the list into short sentences.

decisions.choice: el dinero del que pasa [por el censo]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies in brackets what the passing refers to, the census tax (m2), since "el que pasa" alone would make no sense in Spanish.

decisions.choice: "tiền của người qua [kiểm tra]" (L); "tiền thuế của những người được kiểm tra" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The phrase is the half-shekel paid by each one counted in a census (m2), not money in circulation.

decisions.choice: The king speaks to the priests in the plain style here; he is still young and under Jehoiada's teaching
decisions.reason: The king gives an order to the temple priests; in verse 8, where he summons Jehoiada himself, he uses 하오체 out of respect for his guardian.

decisions.choice: "[인구 조사를] 지나가는 자의 돈" at Literal
decisions.reason: Korean "지나가다" needs an object to make sense; the bracket supplies the census, as the meaning decision explains (m2).

decisions.choice: a prata (L); o dinheiro (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole passage (verses 5-17): the Hebrew word is "silver", and there were no coins yet; payments were silver weighed out (verse 12, m1). Literal says "prata", the word itself; Balanced and Readable say "dinheiro", as the English says "money", since "prata" alone would make Portuguese readers think of silver objects. The census tax (m2) is bracketed at Literal as "[quem] passa [pelo censo]" and explained at Readable, as the English does.

ko.R: 제사장들은 그 돈을 저마다 자기가 아는 사람들에게서 받아라. 그리고 성전에서 부서진 곳을 찾으면 어디든지 고쳐라."

pt.L: que os sacerdotes [a] tomem para si, cada um da parte do seu conhecido, e eles repararão a brecha da casa, onde quer que se ache uma brecha."
pt.B: os sacerdotes devem recebê-lo, cada um das pessoas que conhece, e devem reparar os danos da casa, onde quer que se encontrem danos."
pt.R: Os sacerdotes devem receber esse dinheiro, cada um das pessoas que ele conhece, e devem consertar o templo onde quer que encontrem estragos."

decisions.choice: his acquaintance: a person the priest knew; perhaps a donor or a temple assessor
decisions.reason: The word is found only here and in verse 8. It comes from the verb "to know" or "to recognize", so it most likely means someone the priest knew: the worshipers each priest dealt with brought their money to him. Others take it to name a temple official who valued the gifts, or the donor himself. What the word means for the story is clear in any case: the money passed through the priests' own hands.

decisions.choice: breach: damage to the building needing repair
decisions.reason: The word means a breach or crack, and so any part of the building that had broken down. Athaliah's sons had broken into the house of God and used its holy things for the Baals (2 Chronicles 24:7).

decisions.choice: let the priests take: the king's command
decisions.reason: The verb is a command in the third person. The priests were to receive the money and themselves see to the repairs.

decisions.choice: the people he knows
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "the people he knows" for the uncertain word (m1); Literal keeps "acquaintance".

decisions.choice: "자기가 아는 사람" for "his acquaintance"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision leaves open who the acquaintance was (m1); Korean keeps the plain sense.

decisions.choice: o seu conhecido (L); as pessoas que conhece (B, R)
decisions.reason: The uncertain word (m1) is read as the meaning note prefers, from the verb "to know": "conhecido" at Literal, "as pessoas que conhece" at Balanced and Readable, as the English. The note keeps the other reading, a temple official.

en.L: And it was in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash, the priests had not repaired the breach of the house.
en.B: But by the twenty-third year of King Jehoash, the priests still had not repaired the damage to the house.
en.R: But by the time King Jehoash had been ruling for twenty-three years, the priests had still not repaired the temple.

es.B: Pero en el año veintitrés del rey Joás, los sacerdotes todavía no habían reparado los daños de la casa.
es.R: Pero cuando el rey Joás ya llevaba veintitrés años reinando, los sacerdotes todavía no habían reparado el templo.

fr.B: Mais la vingt-troisième année du règne de Yehoash, les prêtres n’avaient toujours pas réparé les dégâts de la maison.
fr.R: Mais quand le roi Yehoash régnait depuis vingt-trois ans, les prêtres n’avaient toujours pas réparé le temple.

sw.R: Lakini mfalme Yehoashi alipokuwa ametawala kwa miaka ishirini na mitatu, makuhani walikuwa bado hawajalitengeneza hekalu.

vi.B: Nhưng đến năm thứ hai mươi ba đời vua Giê-hô-ách, các thầy tế lễ vẫn chưa sửa chữa những chỗ hư hại của nhà.
vi.R: Nhưng khi vua Giê-hô-ách đã cai trị được hai mươi ba năm, các thầy tế lễ vẫn chưa sửa chữa đền thờ.

ko.L: 그런데 여호아스 왕 제23년에도 제사장들이 그 집의 무너진 곳을 고치지 않았다.
