records.literal_gloss: And Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in [the] city of David, and reigned Amaziah his son in his place.

en.L: And Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the City of David, and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
en.B: It was his officials Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer who struck him down, and he died. He was buried with his ancestors in the City of David, and his son Amaziah became king in his place.
en.R: His officials Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer were the ones who killed him. He died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. His son Amaziah became king after him.

es.L: Y Jozabad hijo de Simeat y Jehozabad hijo de Somer, sus siervos, lo hirieron, y murió; y lo sepultaron con sus padres en la ciudad de David; y reinó en su lugar Amasías su hijo.
es.B: Fueron sus oficiales Jozabad hijo de Simeat y Jehozabad hijo de Somer quienes lo mataron, y murió. Fue sepultado con sus antepasados en la ciudad de David. Su hijo Amasías reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Sus oficiales Jozabad hijo de Simeat y Jehozabad hijo de Somer fueron los que lo mataron. Murió y fue sepultado con sus antepasados en la ciudad de David. Su hijo Amasías lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et Yozabad fils de Shiméath et Yehozabad fils de Shomer, ses serviteurs, le frappèrent, et il mourut ; et on l’enterra avec ses pères dans la cité de David ; et Amatsia son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Ce furent ses officiers Yozabad, fils de Shiméath, et Yehozabad, fils de Shomer, qui le frappèrent, et il mourut. On l’enterra avec ses ancêtres dans la cité de David, et Amatsia son fils régna à sa place.
fr.R: Ce sont ses officiers Yozabad, fils de Shiméath, et Yehozabad, fils de Shomer, qui l’ont tué. Il est mort et il a été enterré avec ses ancêtres dans la cité de David. Son fils Amatsia est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Yozabadi mwana wa Shimeathi na Yehozabadi mwana wa Shomeri, watumishi wake, wakampiga, akafa; wakamzika pamoja na baba zake katika mji wa Daudi; na Amazia mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Maafisa wake Yozabadi mwana wa Shimeathi na Yehozabadi mwana wa Shomeri ndio waliompiga, naye akafa. Akazikwa pamoja na babu zake katika mji wa Daudi, na mwanawe Amazia akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Maafisa wake Yozabadi mwana wa Shimeathi na Yehozabadi mwana wa Shomeri ndio waliomwua. Akafa, akazikwa pamoja na babu zake katika mji wa Daudi. Na mwanawe Amazia akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: Giô-xa-bát con trai Si-mê-át và Giê-hô-xa-bát con trai Sô-me, các đầy tớ vua, đánh vua, và vua chết; người ta chôn vua với tổ phụ mình trong thành Đa-vít, và A-ma-xia con trai vua cai trị thay vua.
vi.B: Chính các quần thần Giô-xa-bát con trai Si-mê-át và Giê-hô-xa-bát con trai Sô-me đã đánh vua, và vua chết. Vua được chôn với tổ tiên trong thành Đa-vít, và A-ma-xia con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: Chính các quần thần Giô-xa-bát con trai Si-mê-át và Giê-hô-xa-bát con trai Sô-me đã giết vua. Vua qua đời và được chôn với tổ tiên trong thành Đa-vít. A-ma-xia con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 신하들인 시므앗의 아들 요사바드와 소멜의 아들 여호사바드가 그를 쳐서 그가 죽었다. 그리고 그들이 그를 다윗 성에 그의 조상들과 함께 묻었다. 그리고 그의 아들 아마샤가 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 그를 쳐 죽인 사람은 그의 신하들인 시므앗의 아들 요사바드와 소멜의 아들 여호사바드였다. 그는 다윗 성에 조상들과 함께 묻혔다. 그의 아들 아마샤가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 그를 죽인 사람은 그의 신하인 시므앗의 아들 요사바드와 소멜의 아들 여호사바드였다. 요아스는 죽었고, 다윗 성에 조상들과 함께 묻혔다. 그의 아들 아마샤가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E Jozabade, filho de Simeate, e Jeozabade, filho de Somer, os seus escravos, o feriram, e ele morreu; e o sepultaram com os seus pais na Cidade de Davi, e Amazias, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Foram os seus oficiais Jozabade, filho de Simeate, e Jeozabade, filho de Somer, que o feriram, e ele morreu. Ele foi sepultado com os seus antepassados na Cidade de Davi, e o seu filho Amazias reinou em seu lugar.
pt.R: Os seus oficiais Jozabade, filho de Simeate, e Jeozabade, filho de Somer, foram os que o mataram. Ele morreu e foi sepultado com os seus antepassados na Cidade de Davi. O seu filho Amazias se tornou rei depois dele.

decisions.choice: Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer: named a little differently in 2 Chronicles 24:26
decisions.reason: 2 Chronicles 24:26 calls them Zabad son of Shimeath the Ammonite woman and Jehozabad son of Shimrith the Moabite woman. Zabad is a short form of Jozabad, and Shimrith a feminine form of Shomer; Chronicles names their mothers.

decisions.choice: they buried him with his fathers in the City of David
decisions.reason: The usual formula says the king "lay down with his fathers"; here, after a murder, the text says "he died" and then tells of the burial. 2 Chronicles 24:25 adds that he was buried in the City of David but not in the tombs of the kings.

decisions.choice: Amaziah his son: the next king of Judah
decisions.reason: His reign is told in 14:1-22.

decisions.choice: died ... was buried with his ancestors
decisions.reason: The death formula's wording at these levels: "ancestors" for "fathers", and "was buried" because "they buried him" names no one in particular. The verse has "died", not "lay down", and each level says "died".

decisions.choice: It was his officials ... who; were the ones who
decisions.reason: The names stand first in the Hebrew, naming the killers after verse 21; Balanced and Readable keep that weight. "Officials" as in verse 21.

decisions.choice: "요사바드" for Jozabad and "여호사바드" for Jehozabad
decisions.reason: The names follow the Hebrew as the English does; "여호사바드" keeps this official apart from King Jehoshaphat ("여호사밧"), whose name is spelled differently in Hebrew.

decisions.choice: Jozabade, filho de Simeate; Jeozabade, filho de Somer; Amazias
decisions.reason: The killers (m1) take the final "-e" Portuguese adds after a consonant, "Jozabade", "Simeate", "Jeozabade"; "Somer" ends as Portuguese words can. The king's son is "Amazias", as the shared list for Kings has it. The burial and succession keep the death formula of 1 Kings 14:31 and 15:24, with "ele morreu" where the Hebrew says "died" (m2).
